title: Documentation alignment, API UI fixes, modals, and grievance dashboard
summary: Synced FrameworksGuide, DEVELOPMENTGUIDE, and README with actual routes, schema, seeds, truncate scripts, and Core/Model legacy note. Fixed JSON API envelope handling in the UI: Users and Library modals unwrap { success, data } and use BASE_URL for /api requests; notification dropdown unwraps the same. Grievance dashboard fetch() now unwraps GET /api/grievance/dashboard so widgets render (was stuck on Loading…). Core wraps API responses when REQUEST_URI contains /api/ (subdirectory installs). Library linked-user count matches modal list (INNER JOIN users). ApiController normalizes project/user IDs for projectUsers/userProjects.
